text:
deploy-bot: rollout v3.4.2 -> eu-central-1 finished. Kicking off postdeploy smoke (8 probes) https://deploys.redwood/status/2842101112 :rocket:
ciara: smoke shows 3/8 failures: two kv-prefill 503s and one /embed p95 spike to ~1.3s
sre-dan: checking host pool ec1-b, seeing prefill worker restarts and transient CPU/heap bumps around the warmup window
sre-dan: logs snippet: "prefill: upstream 503; worker restart; reason=OOMKilled"
eli: v3.4.2 introduced a tighter prefill concurrency allocator. Suggest temporary request-shedding on /prefill (drop low-priority prefill requests) and soft-pin /embed to v3.4.1 at 20% in eu-central to reduce pressure
ciara: applying request-shed rule for prefill in eu-central and routing embed 20% -> v3.4.1 now. Re-running smoke in 2m
deploy-bot: re-run: 7/8 pass. kv-prefill 503s cleared, embed p95 back to ~360ms :white_check_mark:
release-coordinator: filed RN-5907: "postdeploy: investigate prefill OOMs in eu-central after v3.4.2". Owner: infra. Triage by tomorrow EOD
sre-dan: opening OPS-1410 to collect allocator traces and heap samples during warmup window
ciara: leaving soft-hold on change window for 45m. If failures recur we'll consider rollback to v3.4.1 across eu-central
eli: note for runbook: when tightening prefill allocator, add phased concurrency ramp and canary with lower concurrency caps
deploy-bot: final smoke: 7/8 pass. Actions: applied request-shedding; 20% embed fallback -> v3.4.1; RN-5907 created. :thumbsup:
release-coordinator: thanks team. Monitor dashboards and ping here immediately for rollback decision if anything degrades.
